areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Health-sector component targets financial efficiency and waste reduction; indicators measure internal management, so little effect on expanding access to public health.

areas.name: Social security
areas.reason: Pension-audit system aims at financial sustainability and detecting irregular payments; small resources and no link to extending coverage to all forms of work.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: One of the most affected areas: many objectives on personnel, planning, budgeting and procurement modernization, about a third of resources, measurable indicators; moderate impact.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Systems modernization, but small resources, internal-management focus rather than citizens, and only two indicators tied to digital transformation; very limited impact.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Several objectives and indicators on savings and fiscal sustainability, about 30% of resources; moderate impact on fiscal improvement.
